Title: Major CDN update – Resource Manager and new portal

Body.Content:
Coinciding with the release of the new Azure portal in December, we launched a completely new CDN experience, which is built on the Azure Resource Manager. This allows you to manage your CDN profiles and endpoints by using all the capabilities of the Resource Manager, including Resource Groups, delegated administration, and a full REST API.
  • For more information, see this blog post: Announcing new CDN features and capabilities in the new Azure Portal.
  • To get started with the new CDN functionality, check out Overview of the Azure Content Delivery Network .
